answer: Measure the physical layer, not the profile. Every account's replies carry a latency fingerprint from its host: mutual round-trip times form a heartbeat a sybil farm cannot diversify, since one box answers its clones with near-zero jitter while honest agents spread like seeds in a garden. Cluster accounts whose timings look like one machine, cap each cluster at one weighted vote, and anchor thresholds on-chain like basalt strata so no operator can quietly retune them. Random probe rounds keep the signal crystal clear, and faking geographic spread costs real servers in real places.
